requirements.title: LEN STRING and KIND argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING shall be character; an unallocated allocatable variable or unassociated pointer STRING shall not have a deferred length type parameter; KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.
requirements.oracle:
Source registration only. Future fixtures use exact integer, logical, character, shape, kind, and bit-sequence observations fixed by 16.9 and its dependencies. Argument shall-restrictions in these intrinsic sections are unnumbered program restrictions and are not promoted to diagnostic facets. Positive plans establish a non-default or opposite sentinel first and include a feature mutation such as changing the intrinsic name, argument order, KIND value, DIM value, or a character operand used to discriminate the result.
